page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.48xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8469C processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 192 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per virtual core.

The configuration integrates 8 hardware GPUs offering an aggregate total of 768 GB of video RAM. Network connectivity delivers a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support high-throughput data pipelines and cluster interconnects. The instance includes no local storage out of the box, requiring cloud-attached network storage volumes for operating system disks and working datasets. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an operational and architectural perspective, this profile represents an ultra-dense deployment intended for resource-intensive acceleration. The substantial pool of 768 GB GPU memory alongside 1024 GB system RAM suits large-scale deep learning model training, multi-GPU AI inference, complex physical simulations, and distributed data processing pipelines. Operators must account for the lack of bundled local NVMe storage and public IPv4 addresses by provisioning external network block devices and network addressing separately.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.48xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for demanding parallel compute workloads. Driven by Intel Xeon 8469C processors clocked at 2.6 GHz on a KVM hypervisor, it supplies 192 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1024 GB of system RAM, maintaining 5.33 GB of memory per core. Hardware acceleration is provided by 8 dedicated GPUs delivering 768 GB of combined VRAM. Network communication operates across a 100 Gbps baseline interface, enabling rapid transmission of large datasets between distributed nodes. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating external network volumes for filesystem access and persistence, and it provisions no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the density of its 8-GPU array and high memory capacity, the instance is suited for multi-GPU machine learning model training, large-scale deep learning inference, high-performance computing, and enterprise data analytics workloads.
